_how_to: Watch Mansfield: the video spot at the top right of the front page. It rotates every 10 seconds. To add a video, paste its YouTube link into 'videos' (one link per line, in quotes, with a comma between). The headline and preview picture come from YouTube automatically. To set your own headline, use {"url": "https://youtu.be/...", "title": "Your headline"} instead of a plain link. Vimeo and Facebook video links work too (add a 'title' and an 'image' for those). Videos you add here come first, then the newest 'from_channel' videos from 'channel' fill in. Set from_channel to 0 to show only your own picks.
